Mangalore runs on its port and its refineries. New Mangalore Port keeps cargo moving, MRPL and the MSEZ petrochem cluster at Permude run large process sites, MCF makes fertilizers, and the tile, fisheries and construction trades fill in around them. All of it needs solid, lockable site offices that arrive ready to use. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller; we build steel units and bring them down to Mangalore from our Bangalore factory, around 350 km away on NH75 through Hassan and the Shiradi ghat. See our range of container office models, and this page covers what Mangalore buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Mangalore

Port and logistics operators use them as gate, weighbridge and documentation cabins. Refinery, petrochem and fertilizer contractors use them as project offices, permit/safety rooms and supervisor cabins. Industrial units in the Baikampady belt use them as admin and QC cabins. Builders working across the city's coastal projects use them as construction site offices and watchman posts. For sites that shift as work moves, many buyers choose a relocatable mobile office container that can be lifted and moved between locations.

Mangalore industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial and port belts:

  • Baikampady Industrial Area (575011) — Mangalore's main industrial estate near the port; strong demand for site, admin and supervisor cabins.
  • Panambur / New Mangalore Port (MCF) belt (575010) — the port and fertilizer cluster; gate, documentation and supervisor cabins.
  • Mangalore SEZ (MSEZ) belt, Permude / Bajpe side (MSEZ Colony 575019) — the MRPL refinery and petrochem SEZ; project offices and safety cabins for large process sites.
  • Yeyyadi and the Ullal–Thokkottu coastal stretch — the in-city industrial pocket and the southern coastal construction belt, also served for site and project offices.

Sites outside these pockets — Surathkal, Kulai, or toward Bajpe airport — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Mangalore
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, documentation cabin, admin room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, safety room + store

Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for heavy-monsoon drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Most Mangalore orders are customised for the site and the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation for admin and process-site use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; extra weather and corrosion protection for the coast and the monsoon; and ramps or external steps. We can also supply a storage-and-office container unit that pairs a lockable store with a finished cabin. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Mangalore

We manufacture in Bangalore and dispatch to Mangalore by road on NH75 through Hassan and the Shiradi ghat, around 350 km. Transit is typically 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and a default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. The same plant ships container offices from our Bangalore factory across the South, so the ghats route to the coast is well travelled.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price and after-sales — not a listing middleman. We supply across South India, including container offices delivered to Chennai and our Hyderabad container office builds.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Mangalore depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, weather and corrosion protection for the coast, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and transport to your site. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a container office cost in Mangalore?

Price depends on size, insulation, weather/corrosion protection, partitions, electricals and fit-out. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

How long does delivery take to Mangalore?

We dispatch from our Bangalore factory, around 350 km away on NH75 via Hassan and the Shiradi ghat, with typical road transit of 3–5 days once the unit is built. We confirm the schedule at order stage based on your site location and access.

Are the units suitable for port, refinery and coastal sites?

Yes. We can add extra weather and corrosion protection, galvanised roofing with proper drainage, and the insulation and fit-out your site needs. Tell us the conditions and intended use and we configure the unit accordingly.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your Mangalore container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
